blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Whether or not Vice President Sara Duterte attends the hearing to defend her office’s proposed budget for fiscal year 2027, the Senate finance committee assured the Office of the Vice President (OVP) that it would extend the traditional parliamentary courtesy. “Why not? The granting of parliamentary courtesy has long been practiced even before all this political noise. So we will extend courtesy to the OVP, similar to the courtesy we give to the Office of the President,” Sen. JV Ejercito, who chairs the finance committee, said in an interview with radio dzBB on Sunday. The committee is set […]...
